sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Whole setup sequence
sections.what: Installs packages, copies the example settings if none exist, sets the login address for a Codespace, generates a random secret, sets the tester admin email, then starts the database, applies migrations and loads starter data.
sections.why: The header says it is the one-time Codespace setup, and it stops at the first failed step because of its strict error mode.
sections.watch_out: The settings file is created only once, so later edits to the example do not reach an existing local file.

summary: One-time setup script for the cloud workspace: installs packages, creates local settings, starts the database and loads starter data.
purpose: Let someone open the project and get a working app with no manual steps.
why: The header says it is the one-time Codespace setup. A random secret is generated so no shared secret is used locally.
how: 1) Install packages with a clean install. 2) If there is no local settings file, copy the example. 3) In a Codespace, set the login address to the forwarded address. 4) Generate a random secret and write it in. 5) Set the tester admin email. 6) Start the database, apply migrations and load starter data. 7) Print a success message.
inputs: Workspace variables (Codespace name and port forwarding domain) and the example settings file.
outputs: A local settings file, a running database with starter data, and a success message.
risks: The settings edits use text patterns, so if the example file changes the edits can silently do nothing. The tester admin email is fixed.
debug: If sign-in redirects to localhost, check the Codespace variables and the login address line. If setup stops, fix the step that failed and run again.
